Section 2 of the Misuse of Drugs Act , in this Order referred to as the Act , is amended (a ) By deleting the definition of "cannabis " and by substituting the following new definition therefor cannabis" means any part Of the genus cannabis, or a ny part of such plant, by whatever name it is called;' (b ) by inserting the following new definition immediately aft e r the nevv definition Of "cannabis " 'cannabis mixtures" means any mixture Of vegetable matter containing tetrahydrocannabinol and cannabinol in any quantity; (c ) By deleting the definition of "cannabis resin " and by substituting the following new definition therefore 'cannabis resin " means any substances containing resinous material and in which is found tetrahydrocannabinol and cannabinol in any quantity; lnsertion of new section 6B.

The Act is amended by inserting the following new section immediately after section 6A 105

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM GOVERNMENT GAZETTE "Place Of consumption need no 囊 be stated or proven. 6B. ( 〕 Where a person is charged fo r an offence against section 6 (b ) , it shall be sufficient fo r the charge to merely state that the person charged has smokedr administered to himself or otherwise consumed a controlled drug, without having to state the place where the offence was committed. ( 2 ) Where a person is being tried fo r an offence under section 6 (b ) , it shall not be necessary for the prosecution to prove the place where the offence was committed.' Amendment of section 21.
Section 21 of the Act is amended, in subsection (1), by deleting ' ℃ hief " from the first line and by substituting "Senior " therefor. Amendment of section 33 ·

Section 33 of the Act is amended (a ) by repealing subsection 閂 and by substituting the following new subsection therefor 当 4 ) The Director m ay admit any drug addict fo r voluntary treatment and rehabilitation at an approved institution subject to such conditions as the Director m ay determine.' (b ) by adding the following new subsection 当 司 Every person who has been admitted to an approved institution under subsection 〖 4 ) shall be detained in the approved institution fo r a period of not less than 6 months, unless he is earlier discharged by the Director, where such period shall not exceed 3 years.' lnsertion of new section 33B ·

The Act is amended by inserting the following new section immediately after section 33A "Lawful custody, Every person who has been admitted to an approved institution 33B · shall be deemed to be in the lawful custody of the Director. " 106 18th. FEBRUARY, 2012 Substitution of First Schedule.

The First Schedule to the Act is repealed and the following new Schedule substituted therefor "FIRST SCHEDULE
